# ConnectCar — Car Rental & Vehicle Logistics

> ConnectCar is a Fort Lauderdale, FL-based car rental and vehicle logistics company offering premium car rental with nationwide delivery, professional vehicle transport, and fleet management services across the United States.

## Business Information

- Name: ConnectCar (Connect Car LLC & Connect Logistics)
- Website: https://connectcarservice.com
- Phone: +1 (954) 410-2695
- Email: contact@connectcarservice.com
- Headquarters: 1326 E Commercial Blvd #1124, Oakland Park, FL 33334
- Service Area: United States (headquarters in South Florida)
- Founded: 2022

## Services

### Car Rental
Premium car rental fleet with 80+ vehicles across 10 categories: Economy, Medium, SUV, Large, Van, Pickup, Luxury, Convertible, Electric, and Electric Premium. All rentals include insurance coverage and 24/7 roadside assistance. Delivery available to airports, hotels, cruise ports, and any address nationwide.

### Vehicle Transport & Logistics
Professional vehicle transport for car owners, Turo hosts, and rental platforms. Door-to-door pickup and delivery preserving vehicle mileage. Pricing starts at $100 per 30 miles. Licensed, bonded ($50K), and fully insured with commercial coverage.

### Host & Fleet Management
Car owners can list their vehicles on the ConnectCar platform and earn up to 80% of rental fees plus $50 per delivery. Full management includes insurance, marketing, professional drivers, and a real-time owner dashboard.

### Airport Delivery
Direct vehicle delivery to 10+ major airports including Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood (FLL), Miami International (MIA), Orlando (MCO), Tampa (TPA), Atlanta (ATL), Dallas-Fort Worth (DFW), Los Angeles (LAX), JFK (New York), O'Hare (Chicago), and Denver (DEN).
